programs.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize
programs.desc: All the best moments and bits from Destination Flavour China, led by famed chef and author Adam Liaw.

programs.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
programs.desc: The chef experiences the bustling and colourful fish market in the Sicilian city of Catania and discovers dishes developed through centuries of poverty in Puglia on Italy's mainland. However, he is shocked to wake up one morning to find his vehicle is missing.

programs.title: How Do They Really Do It?
programs.desc: Domino's is the biggest name in the UK when it comes to the highly competitive pizza delivery business. Go inside the kitchens of this pizza empire to meet those involved first-hand.

programs.title: Hotel Chocolat: Unwrapped
programs.desc: A glimpse inside the wonderful world of Hotel Chocolat, one of Britain's best-loved chocolate makers.

programs.title: Jamie Cooks Italy
programs.desc: Jamie is in Tuscany to track down the grandmothers who hold the key to the region's farmhouse cooking. And, he makes a beef stew with homemade pappardelle pasta.

programs.title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia Bitesize
programs.desc: Adam meets Meik Wiking, the director of The Happiness Institute in residential Copenhagen. Together, they cook the Danish national dish, stegt flaesk, and discover how and why Denmark is one of the happiest countries in the world.
